meta.name: writing-skills
meta.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把反复要讲的做事方法整理成可复用的技能包,并在上线前验证它真能跑通
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你总在重复教 AI 同一套做法,想把它固化成可复用的技能
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep re-teaching an AI the same approach and want it saved as a reusable skill.

howto.what: 把测试驱动开发搬到技能文档上:先用子 agent 跑压力场景看它失败,再写 SKILL.md,然后验证 agent 是否照做,最后补漏洞。产出的是可复用的技能文档。
howto.when: 当你创建新技能、编辑已有技能,或在部署前验证技能是否生效时触发。该技能要求先理解 test-driven-development 才能使用。

say.text: 帮我新建一个技能,先跑一遍不带技能的基线场景
say.note: 先记录 agent 会怎么违规

say.text: 改完这个技能后,验证一下 agent 现在会不会照做
say.note: 无测试的改动要删掉重来

say.text: 帮我把这个描述改成只写触发条件,不总结流程
say.note: 描述里写流程会让 agent 跳过正文

howto.what_en: Applies test-driven development to skill documentation: run a pressure scenario with a subagent, watch it fail, write SKILL.md, verify the agent complies, then close loopholes.
howto.when_en: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment; it requires understanding test-driven-development first.

say_en.text: Create a new skill for me, starting with a baseline scenario run
say_en.note: Records how the agent fails first

say_en.text: I edited this skill — verify the agent now complies
Rewrite this description to list triggers only, not workflow
say_en.note: Workflow summaries make agents skip the body
